title: Transport of the published compact-support action to coefficient total limit
statement: Let $K_0$ be a field, $X,Y$ finite-type $K_0$-schemes, and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism with compactification $c$. Let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in $K_0$, and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with its specified valuation ring. Write $F$ for the published integral compact-support functor [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action]. Let $T:D(X,\widehat{\mathcal O}_E)\to D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(Y,\widehat{\mathcal O}_E)))$ and $e_n:T\operatorname{ev}_n\cong R_{!,n}^c$ be exactly the tower and evaluations chosen by [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor]; equality of the tower and heterogeneous equality of its evaluations are hypotheses. There is a natural isomorphism $\rho:F\iota_Y\cong\iota_X T L$, where $L$ is coefficientConstantTowerLimit [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], such that for every integral constructible $C$ and every $n$, $\rho_C\pi_n e_{n,C}$ equals the original chosen Roos projection of sfIntegralCompactSupportValue onto sfCompactSupportTerm at $n$ [def-weil-derived-limit, lem-weil-compact-support-representative-independence].

theorem compactSupportNormalizedTowerLimit
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (K₀ : Type u) [Field K₀] (hk : IsUnit (l : K₀))
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of K₀))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of K₀))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (T : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X) ⥤
      coefficientSequenceRestrictedDerived l E Y)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, T ⋙ coefficientConstantTowerEvaluation l E Y n ≅
      compactSupportRestrictedLevel l E c n)
    (hT : T = Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (exists_compactSupportReductionTower l E K₀ X Y f hk c))).2.2)
    (he : HEq e (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (exists_compactSupportReductionTower l E K₀ X Y f hk c))).2.2).2).2)) :
    ∃ ρ : sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l K₀ hk c E ⋙
        (sfIntegralConstructible l E Y).ι ≅
      (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι ⋙ T ⋙ coefficientConstantTowerLimit l E Y,
      ∀ (C : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) (n : ℕ),
        HEq (ρ.hom.app C ≫
            (coefficientConstantTowerProjection l E Y n).app (T.obj C.obj) ≫
              (e n).hom.app C.obj)
          (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
            (exists_isDerivedLimit_and_iso (sfCompactSupportTerm l E c C.obj)
              (sfCompactSupportTransition l E c C.obj)).1) ≫
            Pi.π (sfCompactSupportTerm l E c C.obj) n)
